fields.summary: KYC Identity Verification — Document Upload and IDV Flow

content.text: As a new customer, I need to upload identity documents and complete IDV so that my account can be activated in compliance with KYC regulations.

Acceptance Criteria: 1) Passport and driving licence accepted. 2) Documents expire >30 days from upload date. 3) AML screening completes within 5 seconds. 4) PEP/sanctions check performed on all new customers. 5) Failed IDV shows clear error with retry option. 6) Audit log entry created for every verification attempt.
